params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly renames fields and their usages from snake_case (e.g., m_path_count) to camelCase (e.g., mPathCount) to comply with the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; all modifications are directly related to fixing the SonarQube warning. No functional changes or unrelated edits are introduced.

Score: 3
